source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original landing requires name, email and token URL parameters. It rejects an existing issuer-origin login with the same username, then saves the supplied token before FetchConfig.fromISP and config-view initialization. This method has no rollback around those later awaits. A matching login is not proof that an account exists. The fixed accepted handler/method instead takes only name and email and has no URL-token save block; its later OAuth flow must remain separate. No live token, endpoint or setup failure was tested.
title: The original Thundermail URL flow saves a token before configuration lookup
